evidence: Source-only criterion-type assessment of the frozen candidate. Workbook Quality Checks!D42 requires binary pass/fail behavior and anchored Likert craft. Internal Quality Checks!E42 says Likert is not used; the frozen skill explicitly resolves that annotation in favor of the shipped Likert format (quality-checks.md:168-170), so Likert itself is not a defect. Parsed all five judge TOMLs and read every criterion: render 1 binary, constraints 1 binary, functional 133 binary, polish 4 binary, visual 5 Likert, each points=5. The functional criteria test exact financial values, permissions, persistence, state transitions or presence/fidelity of required records, rather than degrees of beauty. Examples: task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:95-110 requires exact intrinsic/annualized values; :807-839 requires an audit entry carrying actor, target and before/after meaning and its persistence; :951-956 requires a labelled form and a saved preview of the specified intent, while explicitly allowing different layouts. These presence/meaning requirements do not become craft judgments merely because the content must be human-readable. Polish tests retained revision input plus corrected successful save (:17-24), rescission date retention and successful retry (:26-33), stale-change editor recovery (:35-42), and continuity of the same operation after lost response (:44-51). Each has a concrete yes/no observable; the prompt at :10 expressly assigns recovery rather than visual craft. This fits instruction.md:7. Visual owns typography, palette/contrast, spacing, hierarchy and component consistency. Every block in task/tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:17-90 is Likert with all five explicit anchors; e.g. type :25-29 distinguishes consistent/readable, minor issues, noticeable crowding, difficult important text and broadly illegible text. The same descending degree structure is present for the other four properties. visual/prompt.md:8,12 explicitly uses raw 1 as minimum and :10 leaves layout, labels and styles to the implementer. The candidate therefore supplies the complete stated 1-5 scale; absence of a sixth 0 anchor from the starter is not a missing anchor in this scale. Adversarial source reasoning (not executed apps): a polished recovery form that clears edits or silently starts a new operation cannot pass the corresponding binary recovery criterion, even if attractive. Conversely, an app that preserves terms and completes the same operation using plain but readable table/form layouts is eligible for recovery and functional credit; modest craft lowers its separate Likert anchors rather than falsely failing its behavior. A layout with recurring cramped groups can receive the explicit visual level 3 instead of being forced into all-or-nothing credit. No type-fit counterexample was demonstrated. Python list_checks enumerated 53/48 checks; independent TOML parsing established the counts above. Recomputed all 97 raw-index artifact hashes with no mismatch; index SHA256 cd8a6697e9cad65ac48ca658583bf5a05828d9eece52ab089d6a28c7d7504962. Hash agreement does not establish runtime quality. No Docker or provider run was needed for this semantic row, and no Oracle, reward-spread, full-judge-duration or portal claim is made; those measurement requirements remain outside this row.
